title: Classification of Gapped Ground-State Phases
exact_target: Classify the equivalence classes of infinite-volume ground states connected by uniformly gapped paths of local interactions.

status_qualification: The primary source already supplies the displayed path definition and spectral-flow automorphisms linking equivalent ground-state sets. The broader unresolved task is classification and understanding those phases, not simply inventing the definition. Uniform finite-volume gap bounds, ground-state degeneracy, and optional symmetries must remain explicit.
